explanation: The theorem is about the library's own definitions (disorderAverage, fieldAverage, mapModel). It is a change-of-variables identity for a product measure of pushforwards. The proof relies on the library's own lemma `OAI.DilutedSpinGlass.integral_pi_map`, which is defined in RealEncoding.lean. That lemma is proved from `MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_map_pi` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Constructions/Pi.lean) and `MeasureTheory.integral_map`. I found no single Mathlib declaration stating `∫ F ∂(pi (map g μ)) = ∫ F (g ∘ x) ∂(pi μ)`. Getting from Mathlib to the target needs several steps. Those are unfolding `mapModel`, applying `pi_map_pi` and `integral_map`, and proving measurability. I judged that more than a one- or two-line derivation, so I did not report it as a special case.
